scheduled_vs_simulated: planned_event_utc is scenario demand; simulated_slot_utc is a deterministic queue assignment, not an observed actual time
geometry: 25R arrival STAR/ILS and 25L departure SID common study geometry
runway_caveat: Oct 7 METAR reports R07R and northeast wind; actual runway/clearance unknown, so 25R synthetic tracks are counterfactual study geometry.
weather_basis: Archived METAR/TAF copied unchanged; no numerical weather simulation applied to synthetic tracks.
capacity_basis: Assumed 15-minute combined movement caps 9,8,5,3,3,5,7,8; lower near the observed 18:00 +TSRA METAR, then recovery. Sum 48, not a declared capacity.
route_aware_arrival_sequencing: synthetic arrival pairs checked at 20-second samples for 10 NM horizontal and 20 NM same-heading, regardless of vertical separation, within the TMA
